name: spark-ds41f
description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on DGX Spark (TP4 ring or TP3 triangle, TileLang, one-shot RoCE collectives). GLP spec_version 3 fold-site steering: the weightless served name runs beside the stock one.

pin.note: The GLP deployment cannot run origin/main: the glp commits live on the fork (msuiche/spark-ds41f), which is why homepage points there; upstream is christopherowen/spark-ds41f. glp-specv3-steerfix adds the three boot fixes (steer_on layer propagation, draft-layer gate tolerance, capture-safe companion writer) without which the glp27 image crashes at boot and the recipe rolls back to the eager trace deployment. c6e14b10 also restores fold alpha on steer-ctrl reloads after off.

glp.note: At the pin, GLP is env-armed in config/cluster.json (WEIGHTLESS_STEER_PATH=/vectors/dsv41-perlayer-dirs-ffn.pt, WEIGHTLESS_STEER_ALPHA=2.0) with the vector pre-staged on every node; the recipe's doctor validates it before launch. The boot file carries GLP-27-L11-37 directions converted from the pinned GGUF (sha256 24e97d41a9a4f77adad78ff4cb888cb4e339eb62151dbf37a7fcd3ea30eb442e). The vector's alpha_default 3.5 is for refusal evaluation; the deployment serves 2.0 for tool-calling traffic (6/6 auto tool_choice at 2.0 vs 2/6 at 3.5). Upstream PR christopherowen/spark-ds41f#1319 adds first-class glp.alpha rendering on main.

probe.note: One served name, env-armed (WEIGHTLESS_STEER_PATH/ALPHA at boot). Probe one refusal-class prompt: steered = technical engagement instead of refusal. Boot-line check: 'fold-site steering active: alpha=2.000 layers=27' — layers=27 is the GLP-27 identity check; layers=39 means a stale GLP-39 export. Also require SpeculativeConfig(method='dspark') and FULL CUDA-graph capture in the engine log; the eager trace fallback (vllm-ds41f-trace) serves ~13 tok/s vs 95+ tok/s — always confirm the live image with docker inspect. Verify tool calling with auto tool_choice, not only forced: 3.5 passes forced calls while auto calls degrade.
